# GoAmaze Global Exporters

> Premium Indian Turmeric & Agro Commodity Exporter. Supplying whole dried Salem/Nizamabad/Rajapore Turmeric Fingers and High-Curcumin Turmeric Powder to international B2B importers, food processors, spice blenders, and pharmaceutical brands worldwide.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity**: GoAmaze Global Exporters (Export division of GoAmaze)
- **Headquarters**: 204, Bld 3, Gopi Krishna Complex, Kalyan, Thane, Maharashtra 421301, India
- **Primary Export Port**: JNPT / Nhava Sheva (INNSA), Mumbai, India
- **Contact Email**: sales@goamazeglobal.com / goamazeglobal@gmail.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 7021677207
- **Official Website**: https://goamazeglobal.com

## Core Export Products
1. **Indian Turmeric Finger (Whole Dried Curcuma Longa)**
   - *HS Code*: 0910.30.20
   - *Varieties*: Salem, Nizamabad, Rajapore, Sangli
   - *Curcumin Content*: 2.5% to 5.0%+
   - *Grades*: Double Polished, Single Polished, Unpolished (Bulb & Finger)
   - *Moisture*: Maximum 10.0%
   - *Packaging*: 25 kg / 50 kg new Jute Bags, PP Bags, or customized bulk packaging
   - *Product URL*: https://goamazeglobal.com/products/turmeric-finger

2. **Indian Turmeric Powder (Ground Spices)**
   - *HS Code*: 0910.30.30
   - *Curcumin Content*: 2.0% to 5.0%+ (Standard, Premium, Organic/Pharma grades)
   - *Fineness*: 60 to 100 mesh size (Customizable)
   - *Moisture*: Maximum 9.0%
   - *Total Ash*: Maximum 7.0% | Acid Insoluble Ash: Maximum 1.0%
   - *Adulteration*: 100% Pure, Zero Lead Chromate, Zero Sudan Dyes, Non-GMO
   - *Packaging*: 25 kg multi-wall paper bags with LDPE liner, 25 kg HDPE woven sacks, bulk tote bags, private-label retail pouches
   - *Product URL*: https://goamazeglobal.com/products/turmeric-powder

## Trade Terms & Capabilities
- **Incoterms Supported**: FOB (Nhava Sheva / JNPT), CIF (Destination Port), CFR, EXW
- **Payment Modes**: Irrevocable Letter of Credit (L/C at sight), Wire Transfer (T/T Advance + Balance against BL copies)
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: 1 Metric Ton (Air / LCL), 1x20ft FCL (~18 MT) for ocean container shipments
- **Container Capacities**: 
  - 20ft FCL: ~18 to 19 Metric Tons (Finger in 50kg bags) | ~18 to 20 Metric Tons (Powder in 25kg bags)
  - 40ft FCL: ~26 to 27 Metric Tons
- **Key Export Markets**: United States, United Kingdom, European Union, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Southeast Asia, Australia, Canada

## Compliance & Quality Certifications
- APEDA (Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority)
- Spices Board of India Registered
- FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India) Certified
- Phytosanitary & Fumigation Certification for every export shipment
- Third-party quality inspection available: SGS, Eurofins, Bureau Veritas
